name: ☆DOKI DOKI PABLO IGLESIAS KUN☆
source:
Ever wanted to declare your love to Pablo Iglesias kun? Do you dream of as would a romantic walk on the beach with your loved Pablo Iglesias? Your kokoro can not be separated from hatred to breed?

Well this game is for you, Pablovers! You can now download the Pablo Iglesias dating sim in which you have to conquer your beloved leader.
